prompt: Continue the Relay static/mock implementation with one narrowly bounded duplicate-intent safety fix. The current RelayDispatcher duplicate/conflict guard hashes only payload, while top-level timeout_seconds is an execution parameter. Make the deterministic intent hash include the validated top-level timeout_seconds together with payload so the same slot + same payload + same timeout remains SAME_REQUEST/BLOCKED, while the same slot + same payload + different timeout becomes CONFLICT/BLOCKED. Preserve payload canonical JSON determinism and all existing behavior for stop/abort/cancel/error handling. Keep timeout_seconds inside payload rejected. Preserve missing/None mock-only behavior deterministically. Do not add live provider execution, networking, API/auth/billing/settings changes, schemas, persistence, retry, fallback, or unrelated refactors. Add focused tests for same timeout duplicate, changed timeout conflict, deterministic key order with timeout, and no extra adapter dispatch on duplicate/conflict. Run PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v, python -m compileall -q src tests, and git diff --check.
